summary: A four-building, 750,000 sq ft campus (736,000 sq ft of office and 14,000 sq ft of retail, per Kilroy Realty) developed by Kilroy Realty and fully leased to Dropbox under a 15-year lease signed in October 2017; Kilroy reported completing construction and starting rent recognition on its first phase (about 52 percent) in May and June 2019, and the Department of Building Inspection shows the new-construction permit completed on 2019-09-19.

milestones.text: Department of Building Inspection new-construction permit application 201409045458 filed for a 12-story building at 1800 Owens St (estimated cost $150,000,000)
Kilroy Realty signs a 15-year lease with Dropbox for 100 percent of the office space; project described as under construction
Kilroy reports completing construction and starting revenue on Phase I of The Exchange on 16th (about 52 percent of the 750,000 sq ft project) in May and June 2019

Department of Building Inspection records new-construction permit 201409045458 as complete (status 'complete', completed date 2019-09-19); Kilroy's Q3 2019 report still describes later phases as not yet generating revenue

costs.what: Estimated cost stated on new-construction permit 201409045458 (self-reported for the permit fee)

facts.value: Dropbox, Inc. (15-year lease for 100% of the office space, commencing in phases from the fourth quarter of 2018 through the fourth quarter of 2019)
750,000 sq ft total: 736,000 sq ft office and 14,000 sq ft retail, four buildings (Kilroy, October 2017)
1800 Owens St; the Department of Building Inspection assigned 701, 703, 705, 707 16th St and 1802 Owens St as commercial addresses, with 1800 Owens St as the building address, block 8727 lot 008

open_questions: The map note's 2021 sale to KKR and Longfellow Real Estate Partners for $1.08B (Business Wire), the 2022 life-science conversion (The Real Deal, 2022) and the 2026 OpenAI sublease (The Real Deal, 2026) could not be opened (HTTP 403 for the cited pages), so none of them is recorded here.

No single source read states one whole-project completion date: Kilroy reports Phase I (about 52 percent) delivered in May and June 2019 and later phases stabilizing through 2020 in its reports; the 2019-09-19 date is the Department of Building Inspection permit completion date, which is a permit-closeout record, not an opening date.
Architect and general contractor not found in any source read.
The Business Wire page for the October 2017 lease announcement could not be opened (HTTP 403); the lease facts come from Kilroy's SEC filings instead.

The new-construction permit is recorded under block 8727 lot 005 in the Department of Building Inspection data and the building address was later assigned to lot 008 (permit M887587); the lot relationship is not explained in any source read.
